notes.title: Join the Discord!
notes.notes: [p]Hi Everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]The demo has been released for almost 3 months, and I appreciate everyone who has taken the time to try it out. But I did the silly thing of releasing a demo without any way to collect feedback! To fix that, here is the invite to a brand new discord server.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/F9p4Nv3naH"]https://discord.gg/F9p4Nv3naH[/url][/p][p][/p][p]I would love to hear some feedback about the game, or just join to have a chat with me about anything and everything![/p]
